lines.en: Chase shadows, swim through the woods.
Swim through mud, toward the distance.
Red and white, gliding past the weeds.
In the shallows I turn, tail swaying.
Water like a painting, Showa still.
Water like a mirror, Showa awaits.
Water like a mirror, Showa calm.
Water like a mirror, Showa waits.
Floating up top, sunning my colors.
I hold still by the weeds.
A few petals landed on the water.
You stand on the bank; I see you.
Don't put your hand in my water.

lines.zh: 昭和的花纹只在花林水里显。
lines.en: My Showa pattern shows only in blossom water.

lines.zh: 你的影子惊起一圈涟漪。
lines.en: Your shadow raises a ring of ripples.

lines.zh: 我探头看一眼，又沉下去。
lines.en: I peek up once, then sink.

lines.zh: 你身上没有怪物的味道。
这条溪里有几条我这样的？
lines.en: How many like me live in this stream?

lines.zh: 我认得每个来喝水的人。
lines.en: I know everyone who comes to drink.
My fins are hurt, help me!

lines.zh: 我闻到你的肉香了，昭和！

lines.en: Look at you, Showa, such a feast!

lines.zh: 昭和，来吃吧，这是你的宿命。
lines.en: Showa, come eat, it’s your fate.

lines.zh: 昭和，这里的食物很鲜美。
lines.en: Showa, the food here is very tasty.

lines.zh: 昭和，品尝这美味的滋味吧。
昭和，这是你的最后晚餐。
lines.en: Showa, this is your last meal.

lines.zh: 昭和，你注定要成为我的食物。
lines.en: Showa, you are destined to be my food.

lines.zh: 昭和，让我看看你的脆弱！
lines.en: Showa, let me see your weakness!

lines.zh: 昭和，你会承受我的力量！
lines.en: Showa, you will endure my power!

lines.zh: 昭和，你挡不住我的攻击！
lines.en: Showa, you can't stop my attack!

lines.zh: 昭和，我要让你感到痛苦！
lines.en: Showa, I will make you suffer!

lines.zh: 我的鳞片闪着光芒，你是来当我的午餐吗？
lines.en: My scales shine. Are you here for a meal?

lines.zh: 快走开！我可不是好惹的！
lines.en: Go away! I'm not easy to anger!
I spotted that at the pond bottom.

lines.zh: 三色鳞一闪，我叼走那片菜叶。
lines.en: My tricolor scales flash and I take the leaf.

lines.zh: 你太靠近了！感觉我的存在吧！
lines.en: You're too close! Feel my presence!
Red, white, black. Let me nibble first.

lines.zh: 你是我的猎物，尝尝我的利齿吧！
lines.en: You're my prey. Taste my sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 猎物出现了，我要吃了你！
lines.en: Prey detected. I'm going to eat you!
I'm going to enjoy my prey!

lines.zh: 终于找到你了，尝尝我的鳞片！
水里那点动静，我游过去看。
lines.en: Something stirs in the water; I swim over to look.

lines.zh: 猎物落入我手，准备好了吗？
lines.en: My prey is in hand. Are you ready?

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，尝尝我的牙齿！
lines.en: You can't escape. Taste my teeth!

lines.zh: 猎物就在眼前，享受我的攻击吧！
lines.en: My prey is in front. Enjoy my attack!
My claws will tear you apart!

lines.zh: 品尝我的存在，你逃不掉！
lines.en: Feel my presence. You can't escape!
When the petal shadows tilt, I know.
The grass behind you is moving.
I swim over to drive intruders off.
Lock on me. I'm going to eat you!

lines.zh: 你跑不了，尝尝我的鳞片！
lines.en: You can't run. Feel my scales!

lines.zh: 红白黑的花纹，转到你下游。
lines.en: My red-white-black pattern slides downstream of you.

lines.zh: 我来了，准备好被吃掉吧！
lines.en: Here I come. Prepare to be eaten!
Lock on me. I'm going to taste you!
Lock on me. Feel my strength!
I open my mouth; water splashes.
The surface is too still to be true.
I hug the mud and close in.
My tail can crack like a whip.
This patch of water grows uneasy.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，你动我一下试试！

lines.en: Showa's fangs are sharp as knives.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤厚实，你的攻击徒劳！
lines.en: My skin is thick; your attack is futile.

lines.zh: 鱼鳞反射光芒，刺眼无比！

lines.en: Come closer, and I’ll eat you.
My speed rivals that of monsters.
My tail slaps the water and startles it!
I butt it and push it ashore!
One flick of the fin, a solid hit!
I bite its leg and drag it down!
Red and white flash; I ram it!

lines.zh: Blossom Woods的夜空下，我静静等待！
lines.en: I wait in the Blossom Woods under the night sky.

lines.zh: 附近没有怪物，我可以停留！
lines.en: No monsters nearby, I can stay here.
My home in the calm waters.

lines.zh: 水草茂盛的地方，我出现！
lines.en: I appear where the water is lush.

lines.zh: 这里水质清澈，我选择这里！

lines.en: My domain is the calm waters.
In the blossom waters I appear again.
Under the weeds, my colors flare.
The stream is clear enough to show me.

lines.zh: 红白黑三色，在浅水里散开。
lines.en: Red, white and black spread out in the shallows.
This stretch of water is my home now.
By the sunken stones I appear.
Not far from shore, I swim.
Thrown out of the water; it hurts!

lines.zh: 水被炸开，鳞都翻了起来！
lines.en: The blast blew the water apart and my scales with it!
Lightning hit the water; every fin goes numb!
